is_anopheles.evidence: Although 39 Anopheles gambiae s.l. females were caught, the authors state: 'Only results for Culex quinquefasciatus are presented (Table 1)' (page 3). The study focuses entirely on Culex quinquefasciatus (with An. gambiae Kisumu only used for net quality-control bioassays).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No molecular genotyping of insecticide resistance markers was performed in this study; kdr is only mentioned in the text citing literature.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data or allele frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No field-caught Anopheles were analyzed or genotyped; the experimental hut trial analyzed wild Culex quinquefasciatus entering huts in Ladji, Cotonou, Benin.

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is a primary experimental hut study conducted in Ladji, Cotonou, Benin between August and September 2007.

sub_country_location.evidence: Huts were sited on the shore of Lake Nokoué in Ladji, Cotonou, southern Benin (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted from 6 August to 15 September 2007 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard experimental hut trial evaluating net hole configurations against Culex mosquitoes.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files are referenced or required.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of intact and deliberately holed untreated and alphacypermethrin-treated bed nets against wild pyrethroid-resistant Culex quinquefasciatus in experimental huts in Ladji, Cotonou, Benin. No target resistance markers were genotyped and no data on Anopheles field populations are reported.
exclusion_reasons: Studies Culex quinquefasciatus; no field Anopheles data reported
